enum.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_ACTION
enum.description: Operator-to-IO operations. Values identify complete requests, not individual payload fragments.

entry.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_ACTION_COMMAND_START
entry.description: Start the command named in command, with optional JSON object arguments.

entry.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_ACTION_COMMAND_STOP
entry.description: Request safe cancellation of command; empty command selects the active command.

entry.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_ACTION_RADAR_SET
entry.description: Set the operator radar mode.

entry.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_ACTION_COMMANDS_GET
entry.description: Read the editable operator command catalog.

entry.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_ACTION_COMMANDS_SAVE
entry.description: Save the ordered command visibility items using the expected catalog revision.

entry.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_ACTION_PARAMETERS_GET
entry.description: Read the editable runtime parameter catalog.

entry.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_ACTION_PARAMETERS_SAVE
entry.description: Save parameter name/value items using the expected catalog revision.

entry.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_ACTION_RESTART
entry.description: Request graceful restart of Copilot.

entry.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_ACTION_SHUTDOWN
entry.description: Request graceful shutdown of Copilot.

enum.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_ROLE
enum.description: Endpoint role in operator protocol discovery.

enum.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_DIRECTION
enum.description: Direction of ping or payload traffic relative to IO.

enum.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_RESULT
enum.description: Transfer or operator dispatch result; successful dispatch does not certify flight completion.

entry.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_RESULT_RECEIVING
entry.description: Request header accepted; received_bytes is the next missing payload offset. No operator dispatch has occurred.

entry.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_RESULT_OK
entry.description: Final operator response has ok=true.

entry.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_RESULT_ERROR
entry.description: Final operator response has ok=false.

entry.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_RESULT_BUSY
entry.description: No request admitted; retry with the same identity and content.

entry.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_RESULT_INVALID
entry.description: Request rejected before dispatch because framing, version, fields, or content are invalid.

entry.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_RESULT_SESSION_CHANGED
entry.description: Request belongs to a previous server session; discover current state before a new operator decision.

entry.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_RESULT_CONFLICT
entry.description: Transaction identity was reused with different content, or its retained response has expired. The request must not execute again.

enum.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_CAPABILITY
enum.description: Supported operator actions and IO-to-client streaming features. Bits 0 through 8 correspond to actions 1 through 9; bit 9 enables stream subscription.

enum.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_STREAM
enum.description: Independent IO-to-client streams selected by a subscription.

enum.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_LOG_REPLAY
enum.description: Initial log delivery policy when replacing a subscription.

entry.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_LOG_REPLAY_NONE
entry.description: Start with new records only; clear previous client log history.

entry.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_LOG_REPLAY_HISTORY
entry.description: Replay up to log_history_limit retained records and reset the client log history.

entry.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_LOG_REPLAY_AFTER
entry.description: Replay retained records after log_after_sequence in this server session. Report a retention gap explicitly.

enum.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_EVENT_TYPE
enum.description: Complete finite JSON event envelopes emitted by IO.

entry.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_EVENT_SNAPSHOT
entry.description: Full snapshot envelope: type, contract, schema_version, sequence, generated_at, and view.

entry.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_EVENT_LOG_BATCH
entry.description: Log envelope: type, optional reset, and events containing sequence, line, and severity.

entry.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_EVENT_ERROR
entry.description: Service error envelope: type, error, and optional message_type or details.

enum.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_EVENT_ACK_RESULT
enum.description: Event body delivery acknowledgement or resend request.

entry.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_EVENT_ACK_PROGRESS
entry.description: Client reports the first missing byte and requests remaining fragments.

entry.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_EVENT_ACK_COMPLETE
entry.description: Client verified and accepted the complete event body.

entry.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_EVENT_ACK_INVALID
entry.description: Client rejected the event body without publishing it.

entry.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_EVENT_ACK_UNAVAILABLE
entry.description: IO no longer retains the event. Client resubscribes for a full snapshot and log replay.

message.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_HELLO
message.description: Addressed operator discovery. CLIENT sends server_session=0. IO replies with its nonzero boot token and supported capabilities. The protocol name is copilot-operator-mavlink and protocol_version is 1. A session token is transaction identity, not authentication.
message.field: Destination system; broadcast is not accepted.
Destination component; broadcast is not accepted.
Operator API version, currently 1; distinct from the MAVLink wire version.
CLIENT for discovery, IO for the reply.
UTF-8 protocol name: copilot-operator-mavlink.
Zero in discovery requests; nonzero IO boot token in replies.
Nonzero client connection token, echoed in the reply and retained for retries.
Supported action bitmask in IO replies; zero in client discovery.
Operator snapshot schema advertised by IO; zero if not supplied.

message.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_PING
message.description: Operator liveness request and reply. IO echoes sent_at and supplies server_at. This does not replace the vehicle or GCS heartbeat safety policy.
message.field: Destination system.
Destination component.
Discovered IO boot token.
Client connection token.
TO_IO for request, FROM_IO for reply.
Client Unix timestamp, echoed without conversion in the reply.
IO Unix timestamp in a reply; zero in a request.

message.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_REQUEST
message.description: One operator request header. Transfer identity includes source system/component, server_session, client_session, and request_id. Variable arguments or save items are finite UTF-8 JSON carried in TO_IO payload fragments. IO validates the complete body and queues one main-thread dispatch. No partial transfer may execute or persist any change.
message.field: Exact destination Copilot system.
Exact destination Copilot component.
Operator API version, currently 1.
Nonzero IO boot token from discovery.
Nonzero client connection token.
Exactly 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters representing the operator request UUID.
Requested operation.
Command reference for START or STOP. Empty STOP selects the active command. Empty for other actions.
REL or GLOBAL for RADAR_SET; UNSPECIFIED for other actions.
Expected catalog revision for a save; empty retains the operator API's unconditional-save semantics. Empty for other actions.
Complete JSON body length in bytes, at most 1048576. Zero means no body. START body is its arguments object. Save body is the ordered items array.
CRC-32/ISO-HDLC of the complete body bytes, unsigned; zero for an empty body. Detects inconsistent transfers, not authenticated content.

message.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_PAYLOAD
message.description: Length-delimited fragment of one request or response body. Match the complete transfer identity and direction. Header must be accepted before upload. Receivers reject conflicting overlaps, invalid lengths, invalid offsets, and payloads beyond the declared size. Body parsing occurs only after complete reassembly and checksum verification.
message.field: Destination system.
Destination component.
IO boot token.
Client connection token.
Request UUID matching the header.
TO_IO for request body; FROM_IO for response body.
Zero-based byte offset in the complete body.
Number of valid data bytes, from 1 through 196. Padding bytes are ignored.
Raw UTF-8 JSON bytes. A code point may span fragments; decode only after reassembly.

message.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_REPLY
message.description: Addressed transfer progress or final operator response. Final JSON body contains ok, result, and error from operator dispatch, including reasons, queued cancellation, confirmed fallback, catalog revisions, restart requirements, and deferred lifecycle acceptance. OK means request dispatch succeeded, not flight completion.
message.field: Requesting client system.
Requesting client component.
Current IO boot token.
Echoed client connection token.
Echoed request UUID.
Echoed request action.
Transfer progress or final operator result.
First missing request-body byte offset; payload_size from the request when upload is complete.
Final response JSON body size, at most 1048576. Zero for progress or a bodyless protocol rejection.
CRC-32/ISO-HDLC of response body bytes; zero for no body.
Machine-readable protocol or operator error. Empty for success and transfer progress.

message.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_STREAM_REQUEST
message.description: Addressed subscription replacement. Requires STREAMS capability and discovered sessions. IO acknowledges with STREAM_STATUS. An exact request retry returns the original status without restarting replay. A new request id replaces the subscription and requests a new baseline. Zero streams unsubscribes. Subscription and event traffic do not execute vehicle commands.
message.field: Exact destination IO system.
Exact destination IO component.
Discovered IO boot token.
Client connection token.
Subscription UUID, exactly 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
Complete desired stream selection.
Minimum snapshot publication interval; zero selects the IO default.
Minimum log batch publication interval; zero selects the IO default.
Runtime tick publication interval; zero selects the IO default.
Initial log delivery policy; ignored when logs are disabled.
Last log record already accepted in this server session, used for AFTER replay.
Maximum retained records requested; zero selects IO's configured history limit.
Exact snapshot schema version accepted by the client; required when snapshots are enabled.
Requested subscription lease; zero selects the IO default. Valid addressed client PING renews the lease.

message.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_STREAM_STATUS
message.description: Addressed subscription acknowledgement with effective rates, schema version, and independent snapshot/log cursors. A failed replacement retains the previous subscription. log_gap explicitly identifies unavailable requested log records; it is not evidence of runtime failure.
message.field: Requesting client system.
Requesting client component.
Current IO boot token.
Echoed client connection token.
Server-issued nonzero token for the active subscription; zero when unsubscribed. New replacements get a new token; exact retries retain it.
Echoed subscription UUID.
OK or a protocol rejection result.
Effective active stream selection.
Effective minimum snapshot publication interval.
Effective minimum log batch publication interval.
Effective runtime tick interval.
Effective subscription lease.
Effective retained replay limit.
Latest available snapshot sequence, or zero if none exists.
Oldest retained log record sequence, or zero for empty history.
Newest retained log record sequence, or zero for empty history.
One when requested records were lost to history retention or the requested replay limit; otherwise zero.
IO snapshot schema version; currently 2.
Snapshot contract name, currently src.copilot.operator.snapshot.
Machine-readable protocol rejection reason; empty for OK.

message.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_EVENT
message.description: IO-to-client event header. The complete body is a finite UTF-8 JSON event envelope, at most 1048576 bytes, carried in EVENT_DATA. Receivers publish only a fully verified body. Event identity is source system/component plus both sessions, subscription_id, and event_id; event_id is independent of snapshot and log record sequences.
message.field: Subscribed client system.
Subscribed client component.
IO boot token.
Destination client connection token.
Active subscription token from STREAM_STATUS. Zero is allowed only for a service error before subscription; replaced tokens are rejected.
Nonzero increasing event transfer id within this client/server session pair; unchanged for retransmission.
Snapshot, log batch, or service error.
Snapshot body's schema_version for snapshots; 1 for log batches and service errors.
Unix generation time; equals the snapshot generated_at for snapshot events.
Complete event body byte length, from 1 through 1048576.
Unsigned CRC-32/ISO-HDLC of the complete body, equivalent to zlib.crc32(body).

message.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_EVENT_DATA
message.description: IO-to-client event fragment. Match the entire event identity, reject conflicting overlaps and invalid lengths or offsets, and decode JSON only after complete reassembly and checksum validation. Fragments may arrive out of order after the matching header.
message.field: Destination client system.
Destination client component.
IO boot token.
Destination client connection token.
Active subscription token from STREAM_STATUS. Zero is allowed only for a service error before subscription; replaced tokens are rejected.
Event transfer id from the header.
Zero-based offset in the complete body.
Valid bytes in data, from 1 through 196; remaining padding is ignored.
UTF-8 JSON event bytes; code points may cross fragment boundaries.

message.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_RUNTIME_TICK
message.description: Small uncached IO runtime liveness sample emitted from the main loop independently of snapshot/log transfers. Receipt of other traffic cannot establish runtime freshness. Clients use local monotonic receipt time and require a newer tick sequence for the current sessions.
message.field: Subscribed client system.
Subscribed client component.
IO boot token.
Destination client connection token.
Active subscription token from STREAM_STATUS; events from replaced subscriptions are rejected.
Nonzero increasing main-loop tick sequence within the IO boot; duplicates and older ticks are ignored.
Runtime sample Unix generation time; not a sensor measurement timestamp.

message.name: COPILOT_OPERATOR_EVENT_ACK
message.description: Addressed event delivery control. TO_IO reports progress, complete verification, or rejection. IO answers a resend request with the retained header/fragments, or FROM_IO UNAVAILABLE when retention has expired. No acknowledgement changes command or runtime freshness state.
message.field: Destination IO system for client acknowledgements, or client system for UNAVAILABLE.
Destination IO component for client acknowledgements, or client component for UNAVAILABLE.
IO boot token.
Client connection token.
Active subscription token from STREAM_STATUS; events from replaced subscriptions are rejected.
Event transfer id being acknowledged or requested.
TO_IO for client control; FROM_IO only for UNAVAILABLE.
Progress, complete, invalid, or unavailable.
First missing event body offset for PROGRESS; complete body size for COMPLETE; zero for INVALID or UNAVAILABLE.
